<DOCSTRING>
Represents a user with an age and name, providing methods to check if the user is an adult and to add activities to their history.

Attributes:
    name (str): The user's name. Set during initialization and not modified.
    age (int): The user's age. Set during initialization and not modified.
    history (list): A list of activities performed by the user. Appended to when new activities are added.
</DOCSTRING>
